ajustes.adsense.desc: Publisher IDs and slots for the site's banners. The site reads them live.
ajustes.adsense.inarticle: Ad inserted at the end of every blog post body (mobile and desktop).
ajustes.adsense.infeed: In-feed ad that replaces the third story on the home page.
ajustes.adsense.mobile: Responsive horizontal banner, shown only on mobile and tablet (<1536px), where the sidebars are hidden.
ajustes.adsense.publisher.hint: Publisher ID from your AdSense account. Format: ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
ajustes.analytics.desc: GA4 plus Search Console verification. The site reads them; the GA tag is only injected in production.
ajustes.clarity.desc: Heatmaps and session recordings. The site reads it; the script is only injected in production.
ajustes.clarity.hint: Clarity project ID (clarity.microsoft.com → Settings → Overview). E.g. wzkcreip2d
ajustes.ga.hint: Measurement ID of your GA4 property. Format: G-XXXXXXXXXX (Admin → Data streams → your site).
ajustes.houseAds.hint: When on, the house ads loaded in the 'House ad' collection replace the AdSense slots one by one. Off = every slot goes back to AdSense.
ajustes.houseAds.label: Show house ads instead of AdSense
ajustes.identidad.desc: The colours and the logo the social cards and the reel overlays are drawn with. The text on the cards —the voice, the hashtags, the @handle— is configured under Editorial configuration.
ajustes.modeloImagen.hint: Model for covers. gpt-image-* / dall-e-3 use OpenAI; google/gemini-* use Nano Banana (Gemini) through OpenRouter and need OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
ajustes.modeloImagen.label: Image model
ajustes.modeloTexto.hint: Language model for writing and reviewing articles.
ajustes.modeloTexto.label: Text model
ajustes.modelos.desc: API keys come from env vars: OPENAI_API_KEY (text and images), OPENAI_IMAGE_API_KEY (optional override), OPENROUTER_API_KEY (for Nano Banana / Gemini images) and OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY (optional, only to see the usage above).
ajustes.ok.logo: Logo uploaded. Save to apply it.
ajustes.publicacion.desc: What happens automatically when an article is published.
ajustes.searchConsole.hint: Search Console → 'HTML tag' method: paste ONLY the content value, not the whole tag.
ajustes.subtitulo: The site's external integrations, the visual identity of the social cards and the APIs' usage. The keys live in the CMS environment, never in the database.
ajustes.traducir.hint: Translates every article on publish, into the language set under Editorial configuration. On a single-language site it is worth switching off: it is one model call per article that nobody uses.
ajustes.traducir.label: Translate automatically
ajustes.uso.desc: Live data from the APIs. OpenRouter is prepaid and shows a balance; OpenAI is postpaid and only publishes consumption.
ajustes.uso.err: Could not read the APIs' usage.
marca.accent.hint: The brand colour. The middle of the gradient.
marca.accentDeep.hint: The end of the gradient and the colour veils. It never carries text on top, so it can be dark.
marca.accentLight.hint: Every accent that is text: the large numbers, the quote mark, the url.
marca.bg.hint: The card background when there is no image. It also tints the veil over photos.
marca.hexInvalido: It has to be a six-digit hex, like #1F4E63.
marca.logo.hint: PNG with a transparent background. It is printed at the foot of every card and large on the closing one. Without it the engine's logo is used.
marca.logo.label: Card logo
marca.muted.hint: The signature, the attribution and the labels.
marca.par.title: Headlines on the background
marca.preview.bajada: The standfirst takes the body colour, which carries the most text.
marca.preview.nota: A sample card in these colours. The @handle comes from Editorial configuration.
prompts.analysis.hint: How an article must present itself when there are NO verified news items behind it.
prompts.analysis.label: Analysis-mode framing
prompts.anchors.hint: ⚠️ Each «- key: rule» line declares a key the model is asked for. Adding or removing a line changes what gets extracted: the engine reads the keys from here, it does not have them hardcoded.
prompts.anchors.label: Anchors to extract
prompts.body.hint: The brand voice and the Markdown rules. It is the longest field and the one that most defines how the articles sound.
prompts.body.label: Voice and body format
prompts.borrador.aviso: You are looking at a draft in your own language, to read and edit. What gets sent to the model is the final text, in English: translate a field to update it, or switch to «Show the final text» to review it.
prompts.brandName.hint: The agents write under this name and the social cards are signed with it.
prompts.brandName.label: Brand name
prompts.coverStyle.hint: What the background of the first card must show. It is inserted inside the image request.
prompts.coverStyle.label: Cover image style
prompts.cta.hint: Pasted verbatim at the end of the caption. Empty = nothing is added.
prompts.cta.label: Caption sign-off
prompts.domain.hint: Completes the sentence «You are a journalist writing … for {this}». The writer, the Director, the deduplicator and the translator all read it: say too much or too little and all four drift the same way.
prompts.domain.label: What the site covers
prompts.fabrication.hint: Comma-separated list of the data this topic tends to hallucinate: dates, figures, rulings, results.
prompts.fabrication.label: Facts that can never be invented
prompts.fallback.hint: Used when the model returns no image request of its own. Without it the cover came out black.
prompts.fallback.label: Fallback image
prompts.glossary.hint: A full prompt line. The topic's proper nouns go here: bodies, programmes, competitions, terms with no equivalent.
prompts.glossary.label: What is NOT translated
prompts.guardaCuandoQuieras: Save whenever you like — changes from every step are saved together.
prompts.handle.hint: Without the @. It is printed at the foot of every card, large on the closing card and over videos, and closes the caption as the last hashtag. Empty = it is not printed anywhere.
prompts.handle.label: Social handle
prompts.hashtags.hint: Comma-separated. Empty = the model picks based on the article.
prompts.hashtags.label: Hashtag topics
prompts.identidad.desc: Who writes and what the site covers. It is the first thing every agent reads: the writer, the Director, the deduplicator and the translator.
prompts.imageRules.hint: What is shown, what is forbidden, how faces are avoided. The safety suffix is always appended, even if you clear this field.
prompts.imageRules.label: Image rules
prompts.linea.desc: The rules that separate a publishable article from one to reject. The Writer and the Director share them.
prompts.palette.hint: Two colours, for the duotone finish in the illustration draw. In English, as words and not hex: e.g. «amber and deep-blue».
prompts.palette.label: House palette
prompts.portadas.desc: What shows up in an article's image. The engine draws the medium (photo, illustration, print) per article; here you decide WHAT to show and under which rules.
prompts.redes.desc: Which handle signs them, how they sound and what the Social Studio pieces look like: carousels, stories and clips. The colours and the logo the cards are DRAWN with are chosen under Site and integrations → Visual identity: they are not text and no agent reads them.
prompts.socialVoice.hint: What kind of organisation this is, how it sounds and what is NEVER done. It is an instruction, so it goes in English; the text that gets published comes out in the site's language.
prompts.socialVoice.label: Social voice and hard rules
prompts.sources.hint: Bodies and publications that CAN be named without it counting as reproducing a rival outlet. Proper nouns go exactly as they are spelled.
prompts.sources.label: Citable official sources
prompts.subtitulo: What turns the engine into THIS portal: the agents read it on every run. Each field states which language it takes — instructions for the model go in English, and the language of what gets published is decided by «Writing language». An empty field uses the engine's default, and «Restore» goes back to that neutral value, NOT to the text your project started with.
prompts.themeGuide.hint: THEME → SCENES. Each category offers four variants so two similar articles do not end up with the same cover.
prompts.themeGuide.label: Scene catalogue
prompts.traduccion.desc: Only used if automatic translation is switched on, under Site and integrations.
prompts.traducir.nota: We translate it and show it to you to review: what gets sent to the model is the final text, not this draft.
prompts.translationLanguage.hint: The language each article is translated into. The source is the writing language.
prompts.translationLanguage.label: Target language
prompts.videoDefault.hint: The b-roll Social Studio proposes when none is written.
prompts.videoDefault.label: Default clip
prompts.videoStyle.hint: Appended to EVERY clip. Atmosphere, palette and prohibitions go here (no text, no logos).
prompts.videoStyle.label: Video style
prompts.writingLanguage.hint: The language the agents write articles, captions and cards in.
prompts.writingLanguage.label: Writing language
rss.desc.hint: A topic in one or two words, or the domain of an outlet you already know. Every result is downloaded and parsed before it is shown, so it takes a few seconds.
rss.desc.label: What you are looking for
rss.subtitulo: Manage the news sources that feed the agents' daily knowledge base.
rss.url.hint: Public URL of the RSS feed (XML format).
rss.vacio: No feeds configured yet. Search for sources by topic to get started.
